dialogue.text: Hey kid, nice place you got here.
To be honest, I’ve been kinda down on my luck recently.
I mean I’m even down to my last pack of cigs.
But from the looks of it my luck’s turning around.
I'm assuming you know how things work around here?
Me and you in a game of Menko, with our resources on the line.

options.text: Can't believe people actually do that

dialogue.text: Oh yeah baby, this is the real world now
Forget whatever you've seen about menko, I've got some cards that'll blow you away.
Get ready to part with your stuff kid, we're settling this at the table
